scripts.build: astro build && pnpm build:docs && pnpm check:dashes && pnpm check:docs
scripts.check:dashes: echo 'Checking for em and en dashes (not allowed on this site)' && ! grep -rnE '—|–' src dist docs-app README.md --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.next --exclude-dir=.source --exclude-dir=out --include='*.astro' --include='*.md' --include='*.mdx' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.json' --include='*.css' --include='*.html' --include='*.xml'
scripts.build:docs: pnpm --filter docs-app build && rm -rf dist/docs && cp -R docs-app/out dist/docs
